Strange blue dust filled the Shuttered Workstation and Fafnite Deposit. While trying to come up with an idea to remove the dust, Nemon thought of the Creion.
Crobakhi mentioned that Creion researchers were nearby, and you decided to go find them.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102800_step3: Report the findings from Draupnir investigation
QuestString_STR_HQ2102360_quest_summary_:
The documents found in Reuben's Hideout mentioned the fortress where the High Priest had last been and Archon scripture. Nemon speculated the fortress may lead you closer to the Core.
Find out the location of the fortress from the graverobbers in Basfelt Ruins.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102320_step1: Clear up near the Watchtower Camp
QuestString_STR_HQ2102575_quest_summary_: Search for Protection Serum in the Blades' supply storage near Idun's Lake.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102800_quest_summary_: Menrik reported that the Bakarma Brigade, thought to be long gone, has been seen beyond the portal and asked you to investigate. Go to the portal via the path below the Impetusium and confirm if it was truly the Bakarma Brigade.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102090_quest_summary_:
"He left us behind and ran in alone."

You decided to follow the lead provided by Kolina, the gravekeeper's assistant.
Together with Ulgorn, you investigated the area around the Crypt.

At a dead end, you found one of Brock's colleagues, Wudsson, injured and hiding.
You retrieved his lost belongings and tried to help him escape.

However, Wudsson ultimately succumbed to his injuries.
Before dying, he revealed that Brok had fled alone into the Crypt.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102230_step2: Obtain the recovery potion ingredients from Soft Breeze Spirit
QuestString_STR_HQ2102660_quest_summary_:
"I'd heard there was one particularly special Fafnite."

You decided to rescue Kunpata to obtain information.

After freeing Kunpata, he told you that Chief Muqaka had taken an interest in a particularly unusual Fafnite and claimed it for himself. He also asked you to rescue his fellow Daybreak Society members, who remained imprisoned. You successfully freed them as well.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102460_step4: Find survivors in the east of the deposit
QuestString_STR_HQ2102480_quest_summary_: Mannikiki was pleased to hear you had met the Creion and found a solution to the problem. She asked you to help them until the Creion arrived.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102020_quest_summary_:
"We should test it out before leaving."

The Selvis is an essential device used for long-distance communication. Before setting out in pursuit of the broker, you first needed to repair the damaged Selvis.

Once the repairs were complete, Hadala's voice crackled through the Selvis, urging you to make haste.

Meanwhile, Dinoh, one of the village's more talkative residents, warmly welcomed you despite your outsider status and even gifted you a mount for your journey.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102800_step4: Receive briefing in front of the Abyss Portal
QuestString_STR_HQ2102120_step5: Hear about the legionnaires who infiltrated
QuestString_STR_HQ2102225_quest_summary_:
"Urgent though it may be, you cannot take shortcuts, Nemon."

You attempted to use Urd’s magic to peer into the memories hidden within the scar upon the High Priest’s body.

As expected, the High Priest could not be awakened without the power of the Red Fafnite.

You decided to reinforce the Assembly's barrier to secure its safety.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102200_quest_summary_:
"Well, we have to fight them eventually anyway. We may as well smash our way through."

At the Abandoned Site in Uruthumheim, all that remained was the body of a Nornir murdered by the Blades.

Fortunately, Nemon discovered a Nornir survivor at the Northern Altar.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102650_step8: Go to the place Nemon mentioned
QuestString_STR_HQ2102610_step1: Prepare to rescue Amunta in advance
QuestString_STR_HQ2102660_complete_desc: Talk to Kumrica at Kumrica's Cellar
QuestString_STR_HQ2102400_step1: Investigate the Destruction Archon Underground Fortress
QuestString_STR_HQ2102040_quest_summary_:
"Nemon gave them all that Odyle only for them to stab us in the back?"

Keller's group, who had been siphoning off supplies, finally revealed their true colors.
You took them down with Ulgorn and earned his trust.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102220_quest_summary_:
"She and I have some… shared history."

After obtaining Urd’s Card of Fate, you began delving deeper into the mysteries of Uruthumheim.

Your investigation revealed shattered weapons, fallen Nornir, and lingering Apparitions haunting the ruins.

From the survivor Hallina, you learned that most of the Nornir had been taken to the Collapsed Oracle.

At the Collapsed Oracle, you encountered Gerod, leader of the Blades. As a Dredgion descended from the skies, he departed with a contemptuous sneer, leaving you to face Rathman alone. Under the relentless bombardment of the Dredgion, the Oracle continued to crumble.

After narrowly escaping the collapsing structure, you met Urd, the leader of the Nornir and one of the Three Women of Fate.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102585_step3_obj_1: Search the hideout entrance beneath the lake
QuestString_STR_HQ2102460_quest_summary_: The Fafnite Deposit was covered in a strange blue dust, and the miners seemed to have lost their minds, displaying intense aggression. You must solve the problem to earn the cooperation of the Steel Hammer Merchants in finding the Blood Blades' base.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102781_complete_desc: Talk to Menrik at the Fang Hideout
QuestString_STR_HQ2102390_complete_desc: Talk to Nemon at the Shulak Street Stall
QuestString_STR_HQ2102270_complete_desc: Talk to Ulgorn at the Nornir Assembly
QuestString_STR_HQ2102230_quest_summary_:
"I was able to escape to the Assembly thanks to you."

Before setting out to restore the altars, you chose to rest briefly at the Assembly.

During your stay, you gathered food and clothing for the rescued Nornir refugees, and collected the ingredients needed to replenish the dwindling supply of healing potions.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102650_quest_short_su: Talk to Amunta at Zemurru's Tomb
QuestString_STR_HQ2102460_step4_obj_3: Search for survivors around quarry wall
QuestString_STR_HQ2102015_quest_summary_:
The area surrounding Safe Haven has been contaminated ever since the Dredgion crashed.
To avoid disruptions to future plans, secure more supplies from the village.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102140_complete_desc: Talk to Hadala at Safe Haven
QuestString_STR_HQ2102400_step1_obj_1: Go to the entrance of the Underground Fortress
QuestString_STR_HQ2102130_quest_short_su: Talk to Gamilla at the Temporary Retreat
QuestString_STR_HQ2102260_quest_summary_:
"I see... Grisilla returned to the Sacred Tree."

You and Grisilla purified the Poison Blood that had been inserted deep into the Root of the Sacred Tree.
Grisilla thanked you and gave you Life Essence.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102040_step1: Go to the Temporary Investigation Base
QuestString_STR_HQ2102010_step3: Prepare to go to the crash site
QuestString_STR_HQ2102620_quest_summary_:
"As long as we have the fragments, it can be repaired."

Amunta claimed that there were more members of the Daybreak Society and that he intended to go to them. But before leaving, he wanted to retrieve Zemurru's Totem, which had been taken by Muqaka's search party. Zemurru's Totem is a symbol of liberation and a source of strength for Mau sorcery.

Muqaka's search parties smashed totems taken from Amunta to make them into totems for the Balaur. You found the shattered remains of Zemurru's Totem and the Shaman's Stone and helped restore them.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102280_quest_summary_:
"From what we know, quite a number of Daeva are imprisoned there."

You defeated the Urugugu tribe loyal to the Balaur in the strange canyon.

Meanwhile, Menrik, commander of the Fang Legion, brought word that a surviving Destruction Archon might be imprisoned in the Dranactus Underkeep.

You decided to head to Dranactus Fortress.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102760_step2: Search the apparition in the Collapsed Hall of Fame
QuestString_STR_HQ2102370_step6: Insert Zikel's Seal into the Blood Monument
QuestString_STR_HQ2102280_step1: Hear about the valley that was discovered
QuestString_STR_HQ2102612_quest_summary_:
Though you rescued Amunta from deep within the Prisoners Grotto, he was in dire condition. Lakiba asked for time to treat Amunta and the other Society members before moving against the Black Claw.
Gather the herbs Lakiba requested.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102010_quest_summary_:
"You'll get revenge for your comrades, and I'll find the Fafnite. How about it?"

You agreed to help Nemon uncover the identity of the one who commissioned the retrieval of the Fafnite.
Before following the trail to the broker who arranged the request, you first needed to acquire new equipment.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102100_quest_summary_:
All clues point to the Crypt.
Investigate the Crypt that is so ominous even gravekeepers no longer dare to enter.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102185_step1: Ascend to the next dimension of power as a Daeva
QuestString_STR_HQ2102310_quest_summary_:
"We need to move him somewhere safe and hear what he knows."

After infiltrating Dranactus, you found records written by Mumu and talk with laborers, but learned little of value.

While visiting a tent where the laborers were resting, Menrik found Skarm, one of his legionnaires.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102090_quest_summary_:
"He left us behind and ran in alone."

At a dead end, you found one of Brock's colleagues, Wudsson, injured and hiding.
You retrieved his lost belongings and tried to help him escape.

However, Wudsson ultimately succumbed to his injuries.
Before dying, he revealed that Brok had fled alone into the Crypt.

Check the tree hollows as well.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102015_quest_summary_:
"The villagers are wary of outsiders."

The area surrounding Safe Haven has been contaminated ever since the Dredgion crashed. Ulgorn explained that an ordinary human like him could not survive outside the village without a neutralizer.

With a dangerous investigation ahead, proper preparation was essential.

The quartermasters were reluctant to issue you any equipment. They feared contamination from anyone coming in from outside the village and were especially suspicious of the unusual treatment Nemon had shown you. Thanks to Ulgorn's intervention, however, their concerns were put to rest, and they agreed to provide the necessary supplies.

Ulgorn asked for your understanding, explaining that the village had been isolated for a long time. Dwindling resources and years of hardship had made its people deeply distrustful of outsiders.

Nemon pondered how to win over the Elim.

"Infiltrating while being transformed into one of his guards while he's away is the only realistic chance you have."

Muqaka is said to be both powerful and cunning. You decided to infiltrate while he was away by transforming into one of his bodyguards.

You secured a bodyguard's equipment and an entry permit to his quarters. You're now fully prepared to transform into one of Muqaka's guards.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102150_step2: Find Nemon at the inspection area
QuestString_STR_HQ2102260_quest_summary_:
"I see... Grisilla returned to the Sacred Tree."

Grisilla regained her strength at the Healing Spring after collapsing while trying to fight the Poison Blood alone.
Still weak, she expressed her gratitude and said the Root of the Sacred Tree needed to be purified if the Forest's problems were to be solved once and for all.

You and Grisilla purified the Poison Blood that had been inserted deep into the root of the Sacred Tree.
Grisilla gave you Life Essence as thanks and returned to the Sacred Tree.

The survivors at the Northern Altar were killed by a Blades bomb.
You uncovered evidence that the Blades were systematically kidnapping Daeva.

Hadala, investigating separately, found a witness at the Minushan Site.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102600_complete_desc: Talk to Umbaba at Amunta's Hideout

"Please purify the Earth Altar before another Rift Fissure opens up."

Even the Purifying Forest is not safe from Etheria Rifts.
You restored the Earth Altar while the Spirit Guides worked to contain the rifts.

The Spirit Guide said that restoring the altar alone would not fully resolve the problem. You need to find Sacred Tree Grisilla, who can cleanse the contamination of the Sacred Tree.

Just then, Nemon found Grisilla collapsed at the Water Altar.

"W-With a man wearing a strange mask... Oh, he gave me the creeps..."

Brok admitted that his client was the Blood Blades.
After learning that the Blades were behind the Fafnite raid, Nemon became lost in thought.
Just then, news comes in that the Fang Legion have taken a Blade captive.
Before she left, Nemon suggested checking out the Altgard Monolith in Safe Haven.

Ollen told you about the Monolith. Following the collapse of AION, Empyrean Traces can now be found throughout Atreia, and much can be gained by resonating them with the Monolith.
You resonated with the Monolith using an Empyrean Trace gifted to you from Ollen.

"I'll awaken Odar with the Melody of the Forest."

Ecco was sucked into the Etheria Rift and in grave danger.
You entered the rift and rescued Ecco, and she used her flute to awaken Odar from his slumber.
After revealing the Nornir's whereabouts, Odar asked you to aid the forest's restoration and fell back asleep.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102030_quest_summary_:
"Ugh... This one's especially bitter, isn't it?"

The herbalist who was hiding from the mutants has been rescued.
You gathered the materials in his place, prepared the neutralizer, and shared it with Ulgorn.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102340_quest_summary_:
"I... must atone for my sins."

You rescued the emaciated Reuben from the depths of the Underkeep, where he had been tortured, and brought him to Briskwind Shelter.
On the verge of death, he expressed his wish to atone for his wrongdoings and asked you to release his apparition in the Impetusium when he died. In exchange, he told you the location of his hideout.

"Let's leave as soon as we find the serum."

You needed Protection Serum to enter the poisoned waters of Idun's Lake. You decided to infiltrate the Blades' supply storage to get the serum.

You found the Protection Serum in the supply storage. Finally ready, you set off to infiltrate the Blades hideout.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102770_quest_summary_:
"Unfortunately so! The Blood Barrier's power is already violently wavering. It will tear if this keeps up!"

The Destruction Archon Apparitions were still trapped in the time of their battle against the Dragon Lord. You spoke with them and gathered information.

You learned that the Blood Barrier was being weakened by nearby rifts. If the Blood Barrier fails, the Balaur will be able to breach the Impetusium.

You destroyed the rifts around the Blood Barrier and the Destruction Archons, who had become Apparitions due to their strong sense of duty to protect the Blood Barrier, returned to Odyle's embrace as the Blood Barrier became clear. It is time to enter the Blood Barrier and face Zikel, the God of Destruction.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102400_quest_summary_:
"But it's too dangerous! Who knows what lies in wait for us inside?"

You went to the Underground Fortress, where you were thoroughly defeated. Gerod disappeared, taking not only records of the High Priest, but also an unconscious Ulgorn. He held the High Priest's Fafnite, which Nemon had long sought.

Nemon did not hide her anger toward Gerod, and vowed revenge.

After learning from Ivar that Dranactus Underkeep is located in the innermost part of the Balaur base, across the bridge, you finished preparations for infiltration.
Now you must rescue Reuben, the last Destruction Archon, and Kanir, a Fang legionnaire.

You cleared the path to the Crematorium while searching for traces of Brok.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102360_quest_summary_:
"This must be the location marked on the map."

In the Abandoned Ruins, you found Archon scripture, though it was torn. There were further records concerning a fierce war, the Underground Fortress, and the Blood Sword. Nemon was convinced that the Blood Monument would be the key to unlocking the Underground Fortress.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102340_quest_summary_:
Having completed preparations for infiltration, you crossed to the Balaur base, passed the narrow bridge, and headed into Dranactus Underkeep.
Rescue the last Destruction Archon.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102585_quest_summary_:
"There are people who should never meet. Encounters that are ill-fated from the start."

Your first encounter inside the Blades hideout was with a soulless Ulgorn. Gerod had everything ready, as if he knew you were coming. Nemon was undaunted and faced Gerod head-on, ending the bitter, ill-fated relationship between them.

However, High Priest Hystan's Fafnite had already been handed over to a tribe of Mau.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102065_quest_short_su: Talk to Ulgorn at Quai Campsite

Grisilla said that the Poison Blood had to be purified directly at the Root of the Sacred Tree.
Assist Grisilla in purifying the Root of the Sacred Tree.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102760_quest_summary_:
"Hystan's Apparition arrived safely. As did... Reuben's."

Urd said that you may get information on the Blood Barrier from Destruction Archon Apparitions lingering around the Impetusium. Nemon agreed to follow after retrieving the Apparitions of Hystan and Reuben.

Just as Urd said, many Destruction Archon Apparitions remained near the Impetusium. However, they showed no response until you recovered the nearby remains of Destruction Archons.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102060_quest_summary_:
Ulgorn plans to introduce you to the Quai Merchants, the largest trading organization in Altgard.
With their extensive information network, they might know something about the broker.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102190_quest_summary_:
"A mineral that repels external forces... What a strange cave."

Ecco asked you to investigate the disturbance in Krao Cave, where the flow of Forest Essence was being drained.

Inside the cave, you defeated Test Subject Berk, the one responsible for the disruption.

With Berk defeated, the threat within Krao Cave has been eliminated, and the flow of Forest Essence has been restored.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102380_complete_desc: Talk to Nemon at the Fissure Cave
QuestString_STR_HQ2102115_step5_obj_1: Use the Language Artifact to learn
QuestString_STR_HQ2102160_quest_summary_:
"They... They destroyed our shelter..."

After discovering that the Blades were behind the Fafnite incident, it became clear that the High Priest's body may also be in danger. To learn more, you set out in search of the Nornir.

Your first destination was Odar's Shade, where you hoped to find Urd, leader of the Nornir and caretaker of the High Priest's body.

When you arrived, Odar's Shade had been devastated. The Nornir lay dead, and despite searching the area, you found no survivors.

With only the Young Elim remaining, Nemon knew she had to find the surviving Nornir to learn Urd's whereabouts and confirm the safety of the High Priest's body.

 While searching for survivors, Nemon realized that some of the surviving Elim had fled to the Collapsed Chasm. Without delay, she set out for the chasm.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102460_step3: Listen to a detailed explanation from Mannikiki
QuestString_STR_HQ2102170_quest_summary_:
"Bring them back, and I will tell you."

After the attack by the Blades, Ninir was consumed with rage toward the Daeva. He resented both the destruction of the forest and the suffering of his people.

Several of the Young Elim who had fled from the Blades had not yet returned.

Ninir was currently the only one who could provide information on the location of the Nornir. In exchange, you agreed to help search for the missing Young Elim.

The Young Elim had scattered in panic during the assault. You searched for traces of them through the ruined Elim's Rest.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102060_quest_summary_:
"Come with me. I'll introduce you to the Shugo."

Brok, the lead broker, was being chased by the masked Daeva.
You were told he fled into the crypt and has not reemerged since.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102600_quest_summary_:
"A ritualist called Amunta is leading a breakaway faction called the Daybreak Society."

Crobakhi informed you of a split among the Mau.

Ritualist Amunta and the Daybreak Society harbored strong resentment toward the Balaur. Hoping to gain their support, you searched for their hideout, but Amunta had already been kidnapped by a search party sent by Chief Muqaka.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102185_quest_summary_:
"The pain of AION is etched within you."

You received another summons from the dream.
You came to realize the wretched state of the world in grim detail after the AION Tower fell and Atreia was devoured by the Balaur.

Asahr and the afterimage of Siel faintly revealed the path you must take, as one born of a Fragment of AION.

You awakened your Stigma Skills, imbued with the might of AION.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102770_quest_summary_:
"I will give... my body and soul... to maintain... the Blood... Barrier..."

You removed the incomplete subspace created by the raising of the Blood Barrier and reactivated the Guardian Stone. The Destruction Archons, who had become Apparitions due to their strong sense of duty to protect the Blood Barrier, returned to Odyle's embrace as the Blood Barrier became clear. It is time to enter the Blood Barrier and face Zikel, the God of Destruction.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102620_complete_desc: Talk to Amunta at Zemurru's Tomb

QuestString_STR_HQ2102050_quest_summary_:
"Leaking Drakana has stopped us from trading with the Shugo Merchants."

The supply route used to transport Odyle had also been contaminated by the Drakana.
The lost goods of the Quai Merchants were recovered, and the mutants were eliminated.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102260_quest_short_su: Talk to Grisilla at Healing Spring
QuestString_STR_HQ2102600_step8: Explain the situation to the escaped Mau
QuestString_STR_HQ2102320_quest_summary_:
Fortunately, Skarm, the Fang Legionnaire, was still conscious. He told you he lost contact with his comrades after they headed for the Dranactus Underkeep, and that there was a device in the Watchtower Camp that controls the surveillance facilities in the area.
Investigate the tent he told you about.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102380_quest_short_su: Talk to Nemon at the Destroyed Ruins
QuestString_STR_HQ2102185_quest_short_su: Talk to Ecco at Odar's Shade
QuestString_STR_HQ2102590_quest_summary_:
"Let's head right there."

You need help from the Steel Hammer Merchants to gather information on the Mau. Crobakhi says that if you need their help, you will have to resolve the issue at the Fire Temple first.

You surveyed the Fire Temple and warned the Steel Hammer Merchants about the dangers within.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102345_quest_summary_:
The voice of Asahr calls to you once more.
The time has come to ascend to the next dimension of power.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102400_quest_summary_:
"But it's too dangerous! Who knows what lies in wait for us inside?"

Ulgorn was anxious, saying that the Blades had never been so bold, lying in wait while fully prepared. He suggested finding another way, but Nemon was unwilling to change her mind.

You eventually went to the Underground Fortress, where you were thoroughly defeated. Gerod disappeared, taking not only records of the High Priest, but also an unconscious Ulgorn. He held the High Priest's Fafnite, which Nemon had long sought.

Nemon did not hide her anger toward Gerod, and vowed revenge.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102380_quest_summary_:
"Is Gerod there too? What's he planning?"

You could no longer turn a blind eye to the Blades. Nemon suggested capturing one of the Blades alive to find out their plans. Ulgorn seemed uneasy, but did not object.

You raided the Blades Campsite and successfully captured one of them. He told you that the Blood Blades had already located the Destruction Archon Underground Fortress and that their main force was already there.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102780_quest_summary_:
"This is it. Let's enter the Impetusium."

You passed through the Blood Barrier and stepped into the Impetusium, which had been sealed for centuries. Empyrean Lord Zikel demanded you prove yourself worthy of the Core, and you succeeded in doing so.

"Protect Atreia. Bring low the Balaur. Deliver triumph unto Asmodae..."

The Empyrean Lord's last words weighed heavily on your heart.
Nemon insisted she will reshape the world both inside and outside of the Bulwark, and invited you to join her.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102380_step1: Reduce the number of watchful eyes
QuestString_STR_HQ2102620_quest_short_su: Talk to Amunta at Amunta's Hideout
QuestString_STR_HQ2102015_quest_summary_:
"The villagers are wary of outsiders."

Ordinary humans cannot take a single step outside the village without a neutralizer.
After easing the quartermasters' suspicions, you managed to obtain the necessary gear despite the village's shortage of resources.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102190_complete_desc: Talk to Nemon at Odar's Shade
QuestString_STR_HQ2102240_quest_summary_:
"If they had been lost, healing the Sacred Tree would have become entirely impossible."

A collective effort is required in order to restore the altars one by one.
The Wind Altar was the first stop.

While restoring the altars, you and Nemon came across some Spirit Guides.
They told you that they were trying to remove the Poison Blood from the Purifying Forest.

You decided to restore the Fire Altar and meet another Spirit Guide.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102800_quest_short_su: Talk to Menrik at Fang Hideout
QuestString_STR_HQ2102350_quest_summary_:
"Reuben's Hideout is located in the west of the Basfelt Ruins."

Reuben said that he didn't know where Core was, but that you could find clues in his hideout in the west of the Basfelt Ruins.

You gained information from graverobbers at the Basfelt Waterfall and found Reuben's Hideout.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102470_quest_summary_:
"Creions...? Oh, yes, there were some Daeva like that!"

Strange blue dust filled the Shuttered Workstation and Fafnite Deposit. While trying to come up with an idea to remove the dust, Nemon thought of the Creions.
Crobakhi mentioned that Creion researchers were nearby, and you decided to go find them.

After asking around at the Steel Hammer Merchant HQ, you learned that the Creion were conducting experiments in a small cave by Mahindel River. They were trying to freeze severely mutated Karas until they could be cured.

The experiment failed, but the rapid cooling device developed in the process might help to remove the blue dust that blankets the Fafnite Deposit.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102110_step3_obj_2: Collect the merchants goods from the Pile of Loot
QuestString_STR_HQ2102250_quest_summary_:
Even the Purifying Forest is not safe from Etheria Rifts.
Help the Spirit Guides.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102670_quest_summary_:
"Infiltrating while being transformed into one of his guards while he's away is the only realistic chance you have."

You secured a bodyguard's equipment and an entry permit to his quarters. You're now fully prepared to transform into one of Muqaka's guards.

"From what we know, quite a number of Daeva are imprisoned there."

Ulgorn asked you to investigate the suspicious Urugugu Canyon.
While you carried out the investigation, he said he would look into the whereabouts of the missing Destruction Archon.

You defeated the Urugugu tribe loyal to the Balaur in the strange canyon.

Meanwhile, Menrik, commander of the Fang Legion, brought word that a surviving Destruction Archon might be imprisoned in the Dranactus Underkeep.

You decided to head to Dranactus Fortress.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102175_quest_summary_:
"Odar fell into a deep slumber after the Moslan Forest burned. Only the flute of the spirit Ecco can wake him."

After finding Dart and the other Young Elim at Elim's Rest, you brought them back safely to the Collapsed Chasm.

In return, Ninir told you Odar probably knows the Nornir's whereabouts.
Odar is in a deep slumber, and only Ecco, the forest spirit, can awaken him.

To make matters worse, Ecco was sucked into the Etheria Rift and is in grave danger. Enter the rift and rescue her.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102590_quest_summary_: You need help from the Steel Hammer Merchants to gather information on the Mau. Crobakhi says that if you need their help, you will have to resolve the issue at the Fire Temple first. Investigate the Fire Temple.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102090_quest_short_su: Talk to Kolina at the Neglected Crematorium
QuestString_STR_HQ2102650_step8_obj_1: Go to the Secret Rendezvous Point
QuestString_STR_HQ2102120_quest_summary_:
Preparations for the infiltration are complete.
Question Balaur to find the Fang Legionnaires and determine how to make contact with the Blades.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102225_step1: Check if Hystan's body is safe
QuestString_STR_HQ2102050_quest_summary_:
"Leaking Drakana has stopped us from trading with the Shugo Merchants."

Ulgorn wants to stabilize the situation at the crash site, which remains full of unresolved issues.
Ever since the Dredgion crashed, the supply route used by the Quai Merchants has become hazardous.

The merchants' lost goods were recovered, and the dangerous mutants were dealt with.
Ulgorn was pleased to report to the Quai Merchants that their transport route has been restored.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102460_step6: Find items for the surviving workers
QuestString_STR_HQ2102370_quest_short_su: Talk to Ulgorn at Graverobber Campsite
QuestString_STR_HQ2102255_quest_summary_:
"Time is the only medicine."

Even after the altar was restored, Grisilla could not regain her strength.
You took Grisilla to the Healing Spring.
You healed Grisilla and learned she collapsed from exhaustion after trying to deal with the Poison Blood alone.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102225_quest_summary_: Examine the High Priest's body with Urd.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102210_step1: Clear the way to the Eastern Altar
QuestString_STR_HQ2102615_quest_summary_:
"Return everything to how it once was... Yes, I can empathize..."

After hearing Nemon's reason for coming to find him, Amunta told her about how the Black Claw Tribe was torn in two by the Fafnite gifted to them by Dragon Lord Fafnir.

The younger members of the tribe, including Chief Muqaka, had been seduced by its power and became willing minions of the Balaur. Others, including Ritualist Amunta, were concerned about the loss of their tribal identity.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102255_step2: Report the restoration of the Water Altar
QuestString_STR_HQ2102050_quest_summary_:
Ulgorn wants to stabilize the situation at the crash site, which remains full of unresolved issues.
Help secure the transport route for the Quai Merchants, who are responsible for supplying Odyle.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102120_quest_short_su: Talk to Menrik at Fang Hideout
QuestString_STR_HQ2102380_quest_summary_:
"Is Gerod there too? What's he planning?"

You could no longer turn a blind eye to the Blades. You successfully captured one of them, and he told you that the Blood Blades had already located the Destruction Archon Underground Fortress and that their main force was already there.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102080_quest_short_su: Talk to Tagar at Gravekeeper Camp
QuestString_STR_HQ2102370_step3: Do a favor for Graverobber Dixie
QuestString_STR_HQ2102190_step1: Go to the place Ecco mentioned
QuestString_STR_HQ2102460_quest_summary_:
"That settles it. Fafnite dust must be the cause of all of this."

You went to the workstation containing the giant Fafnite Gemstone, which was thought to be the source of the problem. The workstation was sealed off and filled with blue dust. Nemon suspected that the dust was causing the miners to become aggressive, and the testimony of those you had rescued from the east of the deposit confirmed her suspicions.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102610_quest_summary_:
"Us Mau... We've always revered the Balaur, but this is far beyond admiration."

You found Ritualist Amunta in the Prisoners Grotto. He had been weakened by torture, but his spirits remains strong.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102450_step4: Share the gathered information with Nemon
QuestString_STR_HQ2102202_step1_obj_3: Retrieve the Fragment of Minusha's Heart
QuestString_STR_HQ2102240_quest_summary_:
A collective effort is required in order to restore the altars one by one.
Go to the Wind Altar first.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102010_complete_desc: Talk to Hans at Safe Haven
QuestString_STR_HQ2102350_quest_summary_:
Reuben said that he didn't know where Core was, but that you could find clues in his hideout in the west of the Basfelt Ruins.
Go to Basfelt Waterfall to check out the ruins and find Reuben's Hideout.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102781_step2: Talk to Urd at Nornir Assembly
QuestString_STR_HQ2102185_quest_summary_:
"The pain of AION is etched within you."

You received another summons from the dream.
You came to realize the wretched state of the world in grim detail after the AION Tower fell and Atreia was devoured by the Balaur.

Asahr and the afterimage of Siel faintly revealed the path you must take, as one born of a Fragment of AION.

You awakened your Stigma Skills, imbued with the might of AION.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102690_quest_summary_: Following the information obtained from Muqaka's Quarters, you decided to head to the Fafnite storage in Lagta Fortress. Kumrica was disturbed about the consequences of Muqaka's death, but Kunpata reasoned that it was inevitable. You must investigate Lagta Fortress.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102760_step1_obj_1: Join Nemon at the Outskirts Stall
QuestString_STR_HQ2102370_step5: Join Nemon at the Destroyed Ruins
QuestString_STR_HQ2102330_quest_summary_:
The Fang Legion survivors were hiding in the Hidden Cave along with the laborers. All of them were starving and exhausted.
Listen to their stories.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102810_quest_summary_:
"Strive onward to ascend as the Arch Daeva."

The call of Asahr resonates once more. The time has come to ascend to the next dimension of power as a Daeva.

Having claimed the Core of an Empyrean Lord and endured Empyrean Lord Kaisinel's Nightmare, you were recognized for your potential as a Fragment of AION.

The path to rebuild Atreia and the shattered tower lies in the Fragment's ascension into the Arch Daeva, paving a new way for the Daeva.

Now, you must seek out Fragments like yourself and join them to ascend as an ultimate Daeva—a new, absolute being known as the "Arch Daeva".
QuestString_STR_HQ2102781_step4: Bid farewell at the Nornir Assembly
QuestString_STR_HQ2102680_quest_summary_:
"I tried being stealthy, but I messed up. Sorry."

Nemon let her impatience get the better of her. While you were gathering materials for transformation, she infiltrated Muqaka's quarters on her own. By the time you arrived, she had already been captured by Muqaka's guards. Fortunately, you arrived in time to rescue her.

Afterward, you searched Muqaka's Quarters and discovered that the High Priest's Fafnite had been transferred to Lagta Fortress. Muqaka returned as you were searching, and you ultimately defeated him.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102170_step9: Go to the location Nemon mentioned
QuestString_STR_HQ2102340_step3: Discuss further plans with the group
QuestString_STR_HQ2102620_step1_obj_1: Search the Pile of Broken Totems

QuestString_STR_HQ2102620_quest_summary_:
"As long as we have the fragments, it can be repaired."

Before leaving the hideout, Amunta wanted to retrieve Zemurru's Totem, which had been taken by Muqaka's search party. Zemurru's Totem is a symbol of liberation and a source of strength for Mau sorcery.

Muqaka's search parties smashed totems taken from Amunta to make them into totems for the Balaur. You found the shattered remains of Zemurru's Totem and the Shaman's Stone and helped restore them.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102565_quest_summary_: You found a Daeva named Pordhet hiding in the Abandoned Campsite attacked by the Blades. Clear the area and speak with him further.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102610_quest_summary_:
Amunta is being held in a grotto not far from the hideout. You decided to rescue him on behalf of the injured Umbaba and the Daybreak Society.
Umbaba informed you of Muqaka's search parties and asked you to protect Amunta. Amunta seems to be a deeply respected leader, or perhaps his meaning to the Society members is even deeper.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102235_step6: Prepare to restore the Spirit Altar

QuestString_STR_HQ2102810_complete_desc: Talk to Nemon at the Outskirts Stall
QuestString_STR_HQ2102575_quest_summary_:
"Let's leave as soon as we find the serum."

You found the Protection Serum in a supply storage near Idun's Lake. Finally ready, you set off to infiltrate the Blades hideout.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102770_quest_short_su: Talk to Nemon at Collapsed Hall of Fame
QuestString_STR_HQ2102105_step5_obj_1: Obtain the Revelation Amulet Enhance Scroll
QuestString_STR_HQ2102260_step2_obj_1: Enter the Root of the Sacred Tree

QuestString_STR_HQ2102010_quest_short_su: Talk to Nemon at Shadow Hall
QuestString_STR_HQ2102320_quest_summary_:
"Reuben! That's the guy Hystan mentioned. The surviving Destruction Archon!"

Fortunately, Skarm, the Fang Legionnaire you found in the North Laborer's Tent, was still conscious.
He told you he lost contact with his comrades after they headed for the Dranactus Underkeep, and that there was a device in the Watchtower Camp that controls the surveillance facilities in the area.

You headed straight to the Watchtower Camp with Nemon, where you destroyed the central surveillance unit and neutralized the Watchtower.
You then searched the camp and found the Underkeep register, where you found the names of Reuben and Fang legionnaire Kanir.

It had become clear that the last Destruction Archon survivor was held in the Underkeep.
You decided to head to the Hidden Cave to find the Fang Legion survivors and get more information about the Underkeep.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102090_quest_summary_:
The gravekeeper's assistant Kolina provided some information.
Investigate the area around the Crypt.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102781_step5: Bid farewell at the Steel Hammer Merchants
QuestString_STR_HQ2102650_quest_summary_:
"Now it's our turn to help you."

Amunta told you that the Black Claw are responsible for the recovery and management of Fafnite produced in Altgard, and you would have to search the village to find out where the High Priest's Fafnite was.

You transformed into Mau and infiltrated Black Claw Village.

You met Kumrica, who had also infiltrated Black Claw Village, and heard about Kunpata, who was in charge of transporting Fafnite before being imprisoned.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102680_quest_summary_: Nemon went into Muqaka's Quarters alone. Go to Muqaka's Quarters and find her.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102350_step10_obj_1: Talk to Nemon at the Graverobber Campsite
QuestString_STR_HQ2102680_quest_summary_:
"If she ran into Muqaka's quarters unprepared, I dread to think what might have happened!"

Nemon went into Muqaka's Quarters alone.

When you reached Muqaka's Quarters, she had already been captured by Muqaka's guards. Fortunately, you arrived in time to rescue her.

Afterward, you searched Muqaka's Quarters and discovered that the High Priest's Fafnite had been transferred to Lagta Fortress. Muqaka returned as you were searching, and you ultimately defeated him.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102080_complete_desc: Talk to Kolina at the Neglected Crematorium

QuestString_STR_HQ2102650_complete_desc: Talk to Nemon at the Secret Rendezvous Point
QuestString_STR_HQ2102360_quest_summary_:
"This must be the location marked on the map."

The documents found in Reuben's Hideout mentioned the fortress where the High Priest had last been and Archon scripture. Nemon speculated the fortress may lead you closer to the Core. You gathered information about the fortress and scripture from the graverobbers in Basfelt Ruins.

In the Abandoned Ruins, you found Archon scripture, though it was torn. There were further records concerning a fierce war, the Underground Fortress, and the Blood Sword. Nemon was convinced that the Blood Monument would be the key to unlocking the Underground Fortress.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102270_step2: Go to see the high priest's memories
QuestString_STR_HQ2102760_quest_summary_: Urd said that you may get information on the Blood Barrier from Destruction Archon Apparitions lingering around the Impetusium. Nemon agreed to follow after retrieving the Apparitions of Hystan and Reuben.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102310_quest_short_su: Talk to Menrik at Briskwind Shelter
QuestString_STR_HQ2102040_quest_summary_:
Ulgorn finds it strange that the Daeva stationed near the crash site have not sent any neutralizer materials.
Join Ulgorn in inspecting the Temporary Investigation Base.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102480_step4: Resolve the Giant Fafnite Gemstone problem
QuestString_STR_HQ2102340_quest_summary_:
"I... must atone for my sins."

Having completed preparations for infiltration, you headed straight for Dranactus Underkeep. Predictably, the area was overrun with Balaur, but Nemon and Menrik didn't show even the slightest hesitation.

The Underkeep, reached after passing through the Balaur base and across the narrow bridge, was a hell even worse than Ishalgen. You rescued the emaciated Reuben from the depths of the Underkeep, where he had been tortured, and brought him to Briskwind Shelter.
On the verge of death, he expressed his wish to atone for his wrongdoings and asked you to release his apparition in the Impetusium when he died. In exchange, he told you the location of his hideout.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102140_step2: Find the potentially helpful ledger and Zikel's Seal
QuestString_STR_HQ2102225_quest_summary_:
"Urgent though it may be, you cannot take shortcuts, Nemon."

You attempted to use Urd’s magic to peer into the memories hidden within the scar upon the High Priest’s body.

As expected, the High Priest could not be awakened without the power of the Red Fafnite.

Meanwhile, the barrier protecting the Assembly continued to weaken in tandem with the fading strength of the Spirits. Urd warned that the Assembly’s safety could only be secured by restoring every Spirit Altar within the Purifying Forest.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102140_quest_short_su: Talk to Bataar at Sanctum Dumpsite
QuestString_STR_HQ2102170_step5: Discuss the search progress for the Young Elim
QuestString_STR_HQ2102660_step3_obj_1: Follow the tracks of the Society Member
QuestString_STR_HQ2102105_quest_summary_:
Brok admitted that his client was the Blood Blades.
After learning that the Blades were behind the Fafnite raid, Nemon became lost in thought.
Just then, news comes in that the Fang Legion have taken a Blade captive.
Before she left, Nemon suggested checking out the Altgard Monolith in Safe Haven.
Go to Ruins Administrator Ollen and learn about the Monolith.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102200_quest_summary_: Go to Uruthumheim as Odar instructed, and search for the whereabouts of the Nornir.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102390_quest_summary_:
"...I've got a bad feeling about this, Nemon."

Nemon seemed shocked that the Blades had found the Underground Fortress first. Ulgorn insisted upon a retreat as it was dangerous to confront the Blades head-on, but Nemon was adamant.

It was as if Gerod knew Nemon's every move. You headed to the Shulak Street Stall to get the Archon Sword, but once again, the Blades were one step ahead, and had even ensured Nemon would receive a sword.
Ulgorn said it was reckless to confront them and suggested finding another way, but Nemon was unwilling to change her mind.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102080_step1: Clear the path to the crematorium
QuestString_STR_HQ2102060_quest_summary_:
"Come with me. I'll introduce you to the Shugo."

Ulgorn led you to the Quai Merchants, the largest trading organization in Altgard. With their extensive network of contacts, he believed they might know something about the missing broker.

However, upon arriving at the Quai Campsite, you found it under attack by a horde of frenzied Daeva who had lost their sanity. Fighting through the chaos, you subdued the rampaging attackers and rescued the merchants.

Questioning their leader, Baba, and the broker's associate, Barvir, you uncovered the truth.

All of the crazed Daeva had once been companions of the missing broker. They had been pursued by a group of masked Daeva and fled to a graveyard only to return completely deranged.

Their leader, Brok, had since escaped into the crypt and has not been seen since.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102800_quest_summary_:
"Anyone you encounter here can become your enemy, nyerk."

Beyond the portal, you dealt with Bakarma, who had transcended his Balaur form.

At the request of the Fang Legion, you met with Koro, a Shugo of the Black Cloud Merchants, to relay what you found there. In return, he told you more about the Abyss.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102235_complete_desc: Talk to Hadala at the Wind Altar
QuestString_STR_HQ2102590_quest_short_su: Talk to Nemon at Idun's Lake Clifftop
QuestString_STR_HQ2102065_quest_summary_:
You decided to enter the crypt in search of Brok.
Meet the gravekeeper at the Nameless Cemetery to learn more about Brok's whereabouts.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102810_step1_obj_1: Complete The One Who Witnesses the Nightmare
QuestString_STR_HQ2102610_quest_summary_:
"Us Mau... We've always revered the Balaur, but this is far beyond admiration."

You found Ritualist Amunta in the Prisoners Grotto. He had been weakened by torture, but his spirits remains strong.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102650_step5: Obtain additional information on Black Claw Village
QuestString_STR_HQ2102250_complete_desc: Talk to Nemon at the Water Altar
QuestString_STR_HQ2102110_quest_summary_:
Nemon asked you to deliver supplies to the Quai Merchants before heading to the Fang Legion.
Meet Baba of the Quai Merchants and deliver the supplies.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102450_step3: Gather information on the Blades' base
QuestString_STR_HQ2102300_quest_summary_:
"Those Mumu can probably tell you more than us refugees."

At the Briskwind Shelter, you asked about Dranactus Underkeep and Destruction Archon survivors but were unable to get any useful information. Many people were frightened and withdrawn by the recent incidents of refugees being used as forced labor.

As you distributed Odyle Jelly and food to gather more information, you decided that the Mumu in Dranactus would be a better source of information.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102450_quest_summary_:
"This farce ends here."

As a Shulak on the way warned you, nothing was easy in the south. No one seemed willing to offer help, or even give a sympathetic look.

Crobakhi, leader of the Steel Hammer Merchants, promised to help you if you could solve an issue that occurred while mining Fafnite. If you are to find the base of the Blades in southern Altgard, dominated by the Balaur, you desperately need someone's help.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102585_step3: Find the Blades Hideout beneath Idun's Lake
QuestString_STR_HQ2102480_quest_summary_:
"You'll be able to get rid of the dust with the Creions' device? That's great news!"

Mannikiki was pleased to hear you had met the Creion and found a solution to the problem. She asked you to help them until the Creion arrived.

Soon after, Snotra, who had improved the performance of the cooling device, arrived at the Steel Hammer Workcamp. You accompanied her to the Shuttered Workstation, where she succeeded in freezing the giant gemstone to remove the dust. The blue dust that had filled the Shuttered Workstation froze in the air and fell to the ground.

Now you must return to the Steel Hammer Merchant HQ and ask Crobakhi to keep his end of the bargain.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102201_quest_summary_: Rescue the Nornir survivor alongside Nemon, whom you rejoined at the Northern Altar
QuestString_STR_HQ2102070_quest_summary_:
You need to quickly find where the broker Brok might be hiding among the countless graves.
Help out a gravekeeper who seems to know something.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102600_quest_summary_:
"A ritualist called Amunta is leading a breakaway faction called the Daybreak Society."

Crobakhi informed you of a split among the Mau.

Ritualist Amunta and the Daybreak Society harbored strong resentment toward the Balaur. Hoping to gain their support, you searched for their hideout, but found it deserted and in disarray.

Soon after, Daybreak Society members mistook you for Amunta's kidnappers and attacked. A scuffle broke out, but Popokiki stepped in and helped resolve the misunderstanding. After hearing what had happened, they agreed to let you help rescue Amunta.

"Whatever you do, we... know what you're up to... Nemon..."

You defeated the Blades officer, Tassin.
But the whereabouts of Fafnite remains unknown, and all witnesses have since been silenced.
Nemon was enraged to learn of the Blades' interference.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102130_step2: Discuss the voice that was heard
QuestString_STR_HQ2102230_quest_summary_: You decided to take a brief moment of rest at the Assembly before restoring the altars. Talk to the Nornir at the Assembly.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102565_step1_obj_1: Defeat the Blades Scout near the campsite
QuestString_STR_HQ2102565_quest_short_su: Talk to Pordhet at the Abandoned Campsite
QuestString_STR_HQ2102235_quest_summary_:
"Not that I don't understand where she's coming from."

Hadala struggled to understand Nemon's urgency.
Ulgorn explained that Nemon had good reason to be anxious, and told you of her past.

Although you managed to learn about Nemon's circumstances from Ulgorn,
Nemon was displeased with him for sharing her business.

After talking with Urd, the decision was made to purify the Purifying Forest.
You must go to the Purifying Altar, which has long lay unused, to procure Pristine Purifying Light.
You were warned that a horde of Rampaging Spirits would be coveting the Purifying Light for themselves.

Hallina agreed to guide you there.
You found the Pristine Purifying Light with Hallina's help.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102470_quest_short_su: Talk to Nemon at the Steel Hammer Workcamp
QuestString_STR_HQ2102690_quest_summary_:
"What can we do...? We shall pay a harsh price for helping you..."

With Kunpata's help, you transformed into Mau once again and passed through Black Claw Village, reaching the innermost part of Lagta Fortress, where you found High Priest Hystan's Fafnite in the Fafnite storage. The crimson-colored Fafnite, which resembled the energy of the God of Destruction, was instantly recognizable as Hystan's.

Just then, Balaur from the Lagta Brigade rushed in to defend the Fafnite. Nemon smashed the stored Fafnite, allowing you to escape safely in the ensuing confusion.
When Amunta heard what had happened at the fortress, he expressed deep concern that Nemon's actions might provoke the wrath of Indnath.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102800_step1: Receive briefing at the Draupnir Entrance

Gohok, the caretaker of the Minushan Site, was suffering from frequent raids by the Blades.
Help him recover the relics stolen from the ruins.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102680_complete_desc: Talk to Kumrica at the Kumrica's Cellar
QuestString_STR_HQ2102450_step2: Join Nemon at the Steel Hammer Merchant HQ
QuestString_STR_HQ2102390_quest_summary_:
Nemon seemed shocked that the Blades had found the Underground Fortress first. Ulgorn insisted upon a retreat as it was dangerous to confront the Blades head-on, but Nemon was adamant.
She would not let Gerod win. Find the Archon's Sword and head to the Underground Fortress as soon as possible.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102230_quest_short_su: Talk to Urd at Nornir Assembly
QuestString_STR_HQ2102400_quest_summary_: Ulgorn was anxious, saying that the Blades had never been so bold, lying in wait while fully prepared. He suggested finding another way, but Nemon was unwilling to change her mind.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102100_quest_summary_:
"If those Daeva wearing masks are really the Blood Blades..."

You finally found Brok in the Crypt, which was little more than a den of Karas.
You tried to find a way out, only for the floor to collapse beneath you. You lost consciousness, swept away by a sudden surge of water.

After meeting Asahr again in a dream, you woke up to find yourself in Shadow Hall at Safe Haven.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102690_step3_obj_1: Talk to the Fafnite Storage Watcher

"I was able to escape to the Assembly thanks to you."

Before setting out to restore the altars, you chose to rest briefly at the Assembly.

During your stay, you gathered food and clothing for the rescued Nornir refugees, and collected the ingredients needed to replenish the dwindling supply of healing potions.

"Whatever you do, we... know what you're up to... Nemon..."

At Zikel's Sanctum, you tracked down the Blades and uncovered the truth.

The Blades knew that Nemon was searching for the Red Fafnite.
After Brok, Kraki was brazenly killed once he had exhausted his usefulness.

Before dying, the Blades officer Tassin warned Nemon that Commander Gerod had not given up on her.
The whereabouts of the Red Fafnite remains unknown, and all witnesses have since been silenced.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102600_step9: Find other members of the society
QuestString_STR_HQ2102690_quest_summary_:
"We finally found it..."

Following the information obtained from Muqaka's Quarters, you decided to head to the Fafnite storage in Lagta Fortress. Kumrica was disturbed about the consequences of Muqaka's death, but Kunpata reasoned that it was inevitable. You must investigate Lagta Fortress.

With Kunpata's help, you transformed into Mau once again and passed through Black Claw Village, reaching the innermost part of Lagta Fortress, where you found High Priest Hystan's Fafnite in the Fafnite storage. The crimson-colored Fafnite, which resembled the energy of the God of Destruction, was instantly recognizable as Hystan's.

Just then, Balaur from the Lagta Brigade rushed in to defend the Fafnite. Nemon smashed the stored Fafnite, allowing you to escape safely in the ensuing confusion.
When Amunta heard what had happened at the fortress, he expressed deep concern that Nemon's actions might provoke the wrath of Indnath.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102615_step1_obj_2: Administer herbal medicine to the second member
QuestString_STR_HQ2102781_quest_summary_:
"We should finish off any tasks left in Altgard."

You met with several people and exchanged farewells. Each expressed their feelings in their own way, but most offered thanks for what you had achieved together and blessings for your journey ahead.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102115_quest_summary_:
"We encouraged one of them, Kraki, to do it!"

The Blades Captive spilled everything during interrogation.
The Blades had hired the Hugo Mercenaries to secretly steal the Fafnite, then approached one of the members, Kraki, and convinced him to betray his comrades.

Ulgorn was furious about the Blades' meticulous use of double contracts to conceal their identity.
He insisted that further investigation was needed into the Blades, who had been seen at the Sanctum Outpost.
You decided to investigate them by transforming into a Balaur with Menrik's help.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102080_quest_summary_:
"Let's head into the inner cemetery."

Gravekeeper Tagar mentioned that his assistant at the Crematorium might have seen Brok, and offered to introduce you.

The deeper you ventured into the cemetery, the more wandering dead filled the area.
You cleared the path to the crematorium while searching for traces of Brok.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102120_complete_desc: Talk to Gamilla at the Temporary Retreat
QuestString_STR_HQ2102185_step1_obj_1: Complete The One Who Hears the Voice
QuestString_STR_HQ2102345_quest_summary_:
"I will tell you why you must cross the Bulwark.

Asahr led you to Nartis, the passage where Atreia and the shifting Abyss converge.

Dragon Lord Meslamtaeda had previously tried to invade Atreia through this very path but was held back by Narun, the first Arch Daeva.
Asahr sent you there, and you encountered Narun still locked in battle.

After informing him that the Bulwark had been completed, he faded away without regret, leaving only a Fragment of Sacrifice. Through that fragment, you caught a glimpse of the dream for the future that AION left behind.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102760_step5_obj_4: Recover the remains of the Destruction Archon
QuestString_STR_HQ2102150_quest_summary_:
The High Priest's Fafnite Nemon seeks has fallen into the hands of the Blades.
Now you have achieved vengeance for the mercenaries, speak with Nemon to decide what comes next.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102550_quest_summary_:
"C-Calm down, kru! I'll tell you where we make our trades with them instead!"

Crobakhi said he does not know the exact location of the Blood Blades' base, but provided the location of the Merchant's Yard where the Steel Hammer Merchants hand over the Fafnite gemstones. It is up to you to find further clues to narrow down the location of their base.

You learned that the Blades have their base below Idun's Lake at the top of Gribade Canyon. You also found Pordhet, a Daeva hiding at a nearby Abandoned Campsite.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102612_quest_summary_:
"There are supplies near the Prisoners Grotto. There should be herbs among them that I can brew into medicine."

You gathered the herbs Lakiba asked for.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102130_quest_summary_:
Locate the Fang Legionnaires who are hiding from the Balaur.
They hold the key to accessing Zikel's Sanctum.

"...Here at... the dumpsite... Send... help..."

You needed to locate the Fang Legionnaires who were hiding from the Balaur in order to enter Zikel's Sanctum.

Wounded Fang Legionnaires were found at the Sanctum Dumpsite. But soon after, a force of Balaur noticed your presence and attacked.
After repelling the enemy, Bataar of the Fang Legion revealed the existence of a hidden door leading to Zikel's Sanctum.

To gain passage through the secret entrance, Zikel's Seal is required.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102330_quest_summary_:
"In the very center of the Balaur base, across the bridge."

In the Hidden Cave, you found Ivar, an unconscious Fang Legionnaire, and a group of laborers who had been unable to escape.
You decided to transform them into Draconutes and send them to Briskwind Shelter. 

In the meantime, Ivar awoke and informed you that Dranactus Underkeep was located in the innermost part of the Balaur base, across the bridge. Now you must rescue Reuben, the last Destruction Archon, and Kanir, a Fang legionnaire.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102100_quest_summary_:
"If those Daeva wearing masks are really the Blood Blades..."

All leads pointed to the Crypt.
The ominous Crypt, avoided even by gravekeepers, is a den of Karas just as the rumors suggested.

As expected, Brok was hiding inside.
While interrogating him, the entrance suddenly sealed itself, as if forbidding any disturbance of the dead's rest.

While searching for an exit, you were attacked by the mutated corpses of buried villagers.
You pressed on deeper into the Crypt to find a way out, but the floor collapsed beneath you, and you lost consciousness, swept away by a sudden surge of water.

You met Asahr in a dream. Once you finished talking to him, you woke up to find yourself in Shadow Hall at Safe Haven.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102010_quest_summary_:
"You'll get revenge for your comrades, and I'll find the Fafnite. How about it?"

The Hugo Mercenaries were completely wiped out during their attempt to retrieve the Red Fafnite from Fafnir Fortress in Ishalgen.

Inside the fortress, you encountered Nemon. After joining forces to escape, you followed her to Safe Haven.

With no clear leads to pursue, Nemon suggested investigating the person who had commissioned the mercenaries to retrieve the Fafnite. There were still far too many unanswered questions about what had happened inside the fortress.

Before beginning the investigation, you needed better equipment. While Ulgorn seemed puzzled by the special attention Nemon showed you, he nonetheless introduced you to the village's quartermaster.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102202_quest_short_su: Talk to Hadala at Minushan Site
QuestString_STR_HQ2102350_step6: Investigate the Marauder base near the entrance of the ruins
QuestString_STR_HQ2102750_quest_summary_:
After a long tracking, we finally got our hands on the High Priest Hystan's Fafnite.
It was time to awaken the high priest and find the Core of the Destruction.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102620_step1: Collect materials to repair Zemurru's Totem
QuestString_STR_HQ2102201_quest_summary_:
"We only need Nemon alive!"

The Nornir stationed at the Northern Altar were abducted by the Blades.
A rescue attempt was made, but a bomb detonated, killing everyone involved.

While investigating the area, evidence was uncovered suggesting that the Blades were preparing to move more captured Daeva to another location.

At that moment, Hadala contacted you. She explained that she was speaking with Gohok, caretaker of the Minushan Site, and requested that you join them at once.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102010_step2: Uncover who is behind the Ishalgen commission

QuestString_STR_HQ2102750_quest_summary_:
"Please, answer me. Where is the Empyrean Lord Zikel's Core?"

After a long pursuit, you finally have High Priest Hystan's Fafnite.
Back at the Nornir Assembly, you were able to awaken High Priest Hystan's body with Urd's help and discover the whereabouts of the Core.

Much to your surprise, Zikel's Core is in the Impetusium—the place where Empyrean Lord Zikel and a hundred Destruction Archons risked their lives to erect the Blood Barrier and capture Dragon Lord Fafnir. To find the Core, you must enter the Impetusium.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102810_quest_short_su: Talk to Koro at the Abyss Base

QuestString_STR_HQ2102110_quest_summary_:
"Ooh! Odyle Jelly? Does this mean the supply lines are back up and running?"

Before meeting the Fang Legion, Nemon requested a stop at the Quai Merchants.
You delivered the Odyle Jelly as Nemon asked, and Baba requested that you recover the Fang Legion's stolen supplies from outlaws.
The supplies were retrieved from the outlaws and delivered to Menrik of the Fang Legion.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102020_quest_summary_:
"We should test it out before leaving."

Once the repairs were complete, Hadala's voice crackled through the Selvis, urging you to make haste.

Meanwhile, Dinoh, one of the village's more talkative residents, warmly welcomed you despite your outsider status and even gifted you a mount for your journey.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102130_quest_summary_:
"...Here at... the dumpsite... Send... help..."

Wounded Fang Legionnaires were found at the Sanctum Dumpsite.
After repelling the enemy, you learned of the existence of a hidden door leading to Zikel's Sanctum.

To gain passage through the secret entrance, Zikel's Seal is required.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102330_step1_obj_3: Search for food and recovery potions from the supply chest
QuestString_STR_HQ2102105_quest_summary_:
"W-With a man wearing a strange mask... Oh, he gave me the creeps..."

Brok admitted that his client was the Blood Blades.
After learning that the Blades were behind the Fafnite raid, Nemon became lost in thought.
Just then, news comes in that the Fang Legion have taken a Blade captive.
Before she left, Nemon suggested checking out the Altgard Monolith in Safe Haven.

Ollen told you about the Monolith. Following the collapse of AION, Empyrean Traces can now be found throughout Atreia, and much can be gained by resonating them with the Monolith.
You resonated with the Monolith using an Empyrean Trace gifted to you from Ollen.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102150_step6_obj_1: Retrieve Nemon's item from the chest in the pond
QuestString_STR_HQ2102350_quest_summary_:
"Reuben's Hideout is located in the west of the Basfelt Ruins."

Reuben said that he didn't know where Core was, but that you could find clues in his hideout in the west of the Basfelt Ruins.

You gained information from graverobbers at the Basfelt Waterfall and found Reuben's Hideout.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102370_quest_summary_:
"I do remember noticing a particularly sword-shaped boulder. But other than that, it's just a plain old rock."

When you inserted Zikel's Seal into the boulder, a bright light revealed hidden text. Nemon recited the words and realized that an Archon's Sword is the key to the fortress.

Archon Swords can be obtained from the Shulak Street Stall, but the path to it has been taken over by the Blood Blades.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102300_step4_obj_1: Use the Language Artifact to learn
QuestString_STR_HQ2102170_quest_summary_:
"Bring them back, and I will tell you."

Ninir saw the Forest Essence restored and became receptive to helping you.
He asked you to find the young Elim who fled from the Blades attack.
You looked for the traces of Young Elim in the destroyed Elim's Rest.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102650_quest_summary_:
"There's a captured Society member who used to manage Fafnite delivery."

You met Kumrica, who had also infiltrated Black Claw Village, and heard about Kunpata, who was in charge of transporting Fafnite before being imprisoned.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102781_quest_summary_:
"We should finish off any tasks left in Altgard."

You successfully obtained the Empyrean Lord Zikel's Core in Altgard. Before setting out to claim the next Core, you chose to honor the bonds formed with those you met in Altgard.

You met with several people and exchanged farewells. Each expressed their feelings in their own way, but most offered thanks for what you had achieved together and blessings for your journey ahead.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102065_quest_summary_:
"I saw a chubby one hiding in that cave over there."

You decided to chase Brok into the crypt.
You inquired about Brok's whereabouts from Tagar, the gravekeeper looking after the Nameless Cemetery.
With a sneer, he complained that the brokers and a group of masked pursuers had caused a commotion before disappearing.
Tagar added that the person who may have been Brok fled into a cave.

The cave within the cemetery was where those mistaken for Karas had been buried alive.
Among the Karas corpses, you found one of Brok's allies, who revealed Brok's whereabouts.
Ulgorn was visibly shocked upon hearing that the brokers' pursuers were the Blades.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102380_quest_summary_:
You could no longer turn a blind eye to the Blades.
Nemon suggested capturing one of the Blades alive to find out their plans. Ulgorn seemed uneasy, but did not object.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102150_quest_summary_:
"Together, we'll find the Cores. For a world without Balaur."

Nemon is a Daeva from within the Bulwark.
You decided to venture across the Bulwark in search of the high priest's Fafnite.
You found an artifact that will serve as a vessel to harness the Empyrean Core, and finished preparing for your departure.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102565_quest_summary_:
"A river of death now flows through Gribade Canyon."

You found Pordhet, a Daeva hiding in an Abandoned Campsite after being attacked by the Blades. He was a Recluse Daeva who had long lived in the area around Idun's Lake.

Prodhet told you that the Blades had released a deadly poison into the lake, and that you would need some of the Blades' Protection Serum to enter the poisoned waters safely.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102400_complete_desc: Talk to Nemon at Shulak Street Stall
QuestString_STR_HQ2102550_quest_short_su: Talk to Crobakhi at the Steel Hammer Workcamp
QuestString_STR_HQ2102200_quest_summary_:
"Well, we have to fight them eventually anyway. We may as well smash our way through."

Following Odar's directions, you headed to Uruthumheim to search for the Nornir.

At the Abandoned Site, all that remained was the body of a Nornir murdered by the Blades, with no sign of Urd, or any meaningful traces of the Nornir.

Fortunately, Nemon discovered a Nornir survivor at the Northern Altar.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102120_step2: Search for the Fang Legionnaire who infiltrated

QuestString_STR_HQ2102110_step2: Deliver the Odyle Jelly to the Quai Merchants
QuestString_STR_HQ2102175_quest_summary_:
"Odar fell into a deep slumber after the Moslan Forest burned. Only the flute of the spirit Ecco can wake him."

The remaining Blades were defeated and the Young Elim were rescued.
Odar probably knows the Nornir's whereabouts.
But Odar is in a deep slumber, and only Ecco, the forest spirit, can awaken him.

To make matters worse, Ecco was sucked into the Etheria Rift and is in grave danger. Enter the rift and rescue her.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102615_quest_summary_: Lakiba prepared medicine using herbs. Heal Amunta and the Daybreak Society members.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102190_quest_short_su: Talk to Ecco at Odar's Shade
QuestString_STR_HQ2102760_quest_summary_:
"Hystan's Apparition arrived safely. As did... Reuben's."

Just as Urd said, many Destruction Archon Apparitions remained near the Impetusium. However, they showed no response until you recovered the nearby remains of Destruction Archons.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102235_quest_summary_:
Hadala struggled to understand Nemon's urgency.
Ulgorn said that Nemon had a reason to be anxious, and began to explain. Hear what he has to say.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102460_quest_summary_:
"That settles it. Fafnite dust must be the cause of all of this."

The Fafnite Deposit was covered in a strange blue dust, and the miners seemed to have lost their minds, displaying intense aggression. You must solve the problem to earn the cooperation of the Steel Hammer Merchants in finding the Blood Blades' base.

You went to the workstation containing the giant Fafnite Gemstone, which was thought to be the source of the problem. The workstation was sealed off and filled with blue dust. Nemon suspected that the dust was causing the miners to become aggressive, and the testimony of those you had rescued from the east of the deposit confirmed her suspicions.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102612_quest_summary_:
"There are supplies near the Prisoners Grotto. There should be herbs among them that I can brew into medicine."

Though you rescued Amunta from deep within the Prisoners Grotto, he was in dire condition. Lakiba asked for time to treat Amunta and the other Society members before moving against the Black Claw.

You gathered the herbs Lakiba asked for.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102010_quest_summary_:
The Hugo Mercenaries were wiped out in Fafnir Fortress in Ishalgen.
Nemon wants to know more about the Fafnite commission that sent them there.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102670_quest_short_su: Talk to Kumrica at Kumrica's Cellar
QuestString_STR_HQ2102781_quest_short_su: Talk to Nemon at the outskirts of the Impetusium
QuestString_STR_HQ2102450_quest_summary_: The fate of Ulgorn remains unknown, and Hadala and Dinoh have left Nemon. Nemon insists she must end her ill-fated association with Gerod. When it is no longer possible to avoid fate, there is nothing left to do but confront it. So you decided to travel to Southern Altgard to find their base.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102620_quest_summary_: Amunta wants to retrieve Zemurru's totem, stolen by one of Muqaka's search parties, before he is willing to leave the Hideout. Zemurru's Totem is a symbol of liberation and a source of strength for Mau sorcery. Retrieve Zemurru's Totem.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102650_quest_summary_: You reunited with the Daybreak Society at Zemurru's Tomb. You decided to transform into Mau and infiltrate Black Claw Village to obtain information about the Fafnite.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102600_quest_summary_:
Though Nemon had brought an end to her ill-fated association with Gerod, High Priest Hystan's Fafnite had already been handed over to a Mau tribe serving the Balaur.
This could be your last chance. You must reclaim High Priest Hystan's Fafnite before the Balaur get their claws on it again.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102115_step3_obj_3: Collect the Draconute Tinkerer's tissue sample

Explore Krao Cave.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102255_quest_summary_: Restore the last altar for the unconscious Grisilla.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102070_quest_summary_:
"This place is filled with tombs and coffins. They could be hidden anywhere."

Among the countless burial plots, you needed to quickly find where the broker, Brok, might be.
Your only option was to follow the instructions of a seemingly knowledgeable gravekeeper.

Tagar is unmatched in the foulness of his temper.
To gain his cooperation, you cleaned up the cemetery and recovered relics stolen by grave robbers.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102615_step1: Treat the Fallen Daybreak Society Members

QuestString_STR_HQ2102202_quest_summary_:
"These ruins are maintained in commemoration of the victory of the Twelve Daeva over the Ancient Drake Minusha."

You retrieved the stolen relics for Gohok, the ruins caretaker.
Gohok was overjoyed and shared the history of the site.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102320_quest_short_su: Talk to Menrik at the North Laborer's Tent
QuestString_STR_HQ2102030_quest_summary_:
"Ugh... This one's especially bitter, isn't it?"

At the inspection area, Hadala grew anxious as those meant to bring the neutralizer materials hadn't arrived.

Drakana Mutants were full of toxic aura.
The herbalist was hiding in a corner of the Drakana pool to avoid the mutants.
You gathered the materials in his place, prepared the neutralizer, and shared it with Ulgorn.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102120_step6_obj_1: Collect the eyes from Outpost Probe
QuestString_STR_HQ2102130_step4: Obtain the storage key from the Balaur's belongings

Gohok volunteered to be a guide as a token of gratitude.
Head to the Eastern Altar with Gohok.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102480_quest_short_su: Talk to Mannikiki at the Steel Hammer Workcamp
QuestString_STR_HQ2102660_quest_summary_:
"I'd heard there was one particularly special Fafnite."

After freeing Kunpata, he told you that Chief Muqaka had taken an interest in a particularly unusual Fafnite and claimed it for himself. He also asked you to rescue his fellow Daybreak Society members, who remained imprisoned. You successfully freed them as well.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102250_quest_summary_:
"Please purify the Earth Altar before another Rift Fissure opens up."

You restored the Earth Altar while the Spirit Guides worked to contain the rifts.
Just as you were about to head to the Water Altar, Nemon reported that she had found Grisilla collapsed near it.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102115_quest_short_su: Talk to Menrik at Fang Hideout
QuestString_STR_HQ2102040_quest_summary_:
"Nemon gave them all that Odyle only for them to stab us in the back?"

Ulgorn found it suspicious that the Daeva stationed near the crash site had yet to send any neutralizer materials.

Accompanying Ulgorn to the Temporary Investigation Base, you met with the dispatched Daeva. They offered one excuse after another, claiming that Nemon had burdened them with so many assignments that they had no time to deliver supplies.

Before long, the truth came to light. Keller and her group had been secretly diverting the supplies for their own gain. Together with Ulgorn, you confronted the traitors and brought them down.

Impressed by your actions, Ulgorn finally placed his trust in you.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102060_step2: Assess the situation at Quai Campsite
QuestString_STR_HQ2102550_quest_summary_:
Crobakhi said he does not know the exact location of the Blood Blades' base, but provided the location of the Merchant's Yard where the Steel Hammer Merchants hand over the Fafnite gemstones.
It is up to you to find further clues to narrow down the location of their base.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102270_quest_summary_:
"Destruction Archons? You mean that legion under Empyrean Lord Zikel?"

You were able to unlock some of the memories left behind in the High Priest's scar.
From the High Priest's memories, you learned that a man named Reuben had fled from the Impetusium.
Urd proposed tracing his steps one at a time.
You decided to learn more about the Destruction Archons first.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102350_complete_desc: Talk to Nemon at the entrance to Reuben's Hideout
QuestString_STR_HQ2102270_quest_summary_:
"Destruction Archons? You mean that legion under Empyrean Lord Zikel?"

Urd said that you could use the Life Essence from Grisilla to see the memories of the High Priest through the scar on his body.
You headed to the Nornir Altar to see the High Priest's memories.

You were able to unlock some of the memories left behind in the High Priest's scar.
From the High Priest's memories, you learned why his body was wandering Altgard and that a man named Reuben had fled from the Impetusium.

You were unable to find out more about Zikel's Core, only that there might be survivors...
Nemon was frustrated by the lack of detailed information.

Urd proposed tracing his steps one at a time.
You decided to learn more about the Destruction Archons first.

QuestString_STR_HQ2102345_quest_summary_:
"I will tell you why you must cross the Bulwark.

Asahr led you to Nartis, the passage where Atreia and the shifting Abyss converge.

Dragon Lord Meslamtaeda had previously tried to invade Atreia through this very path but was held back by Narun, the first Arch Daeva.
Asahr sent you there, and you encountered Narun still locked in battle.

After informing him that the Bulwark had been completed, he faded away without regret, leaving only a Fragment of Sacrifice. Through that fragment, you caught a glimpse of the dream for the future that AION left behind.
QuestString_STR_HQ2102300_quest_summary_: Gather intel from Briskwind Shelter before heading to Dranactus Fortress.
