QuestString_STR_DQ1203090_quest_summary_:
Luka, một Shugo phụ trách điều trị cho các Thương nhân Tsenka bị thương, đang phát triển một loại thuốc mới hiệu quả hơn trong việc chống độc so với quả Cỏ Dại.

Hãy giúp Luka tìm nguyên liệu cho loại thuốc mới này.

Có vẻ như loại thuốc mới có tác dụng phụ.

Luka chịu trách nhiệm điều trị cho các Thương nhân Tsenka bị thương. Trong khi phát triển một loại thuốc mới cùng với Luka, việc pha trộn các thành phần thu thập được đã tạo ra một mùi hôi kinh khủng lan tỏa, nhưng Luka dường như rất tự tin về sự thành công của nó.

Khi loại thuốc hoàn chỉnh được đưa cho các Shugo bị thương, họ nhanh chóng hồi phục sức khỏe, nhưng niềm vui không kéo dài lâu, vì một tác dụng phụ khiến các Shugo phát ra những âm thanh ngớ ngẩn khi nói chuyện.

Miho bắt đầu làm việc một cách tuyệt vọng để phát triển một loại thuốc mới chữa trị tác dụng phụ đó.

Có vẻ như thuốc mới có tác dụng phụ.

Các thành phần được thu thập từ những ngọn đồi và pha trộn để tạo ra một loại thuốc mới. Những Shugo bị thương đã hồi phục sức khỏe sau khi dùng thuốc mới, nhưng không tránh khỏi một tác dụng phụ kỳ lạ khiến họ phát ra những âm thanh ngớ ngẩn khi nói chuyện. Miho bắt đầu làm việc một cách khẩn trương để tạo ra một loại thuốc mới chữa trị tác dụng phụ này.

Những cư dân của Trại Tị Nạn Eiron ban đầu sống sâu trong các ngọn đồi, cho đến khi một ánh sáng lạ rơi từ bầu trời và những kẻ tấn công đáng ngờ đã đuổi họ khỏi nhà.

Nếu một ngày nào đó tôi có thể trở về nhà...”

Những cư dân của Trại Tị Nạn Eiron vốn sống sâu trong những ngọn đồi, cho đến khi một ánh sáng lạ rơi từ trên trời và những kẻ tấn công đáng ngờ đã đuổi họ khỏi nhà của mình.

Những người tị nạn đã yêu cầu đồ đạc và nguyên liệu thực phẩm để giảm bớt điều kiện sống khắc nghiệt.

Một trong những người tị nạn, Niata, bày tỏ sự biết ơn về sự giúp đỡ, và hứa sẽ chào đón nồng nhiệt nếu ngày mà họ có thể trở về nhà cũ đến, dù ngày đó dường như còn xa vời.

Nếu một ngày nào đó tôi có thể trở về nhà...”

Bạn đã lấy được một số đồ dùng trong nhà và thịt Tog từ đống đổ nát. Niata, một người tị nạn, rất trân trọng sự giúp đỡ của bạn.

QuestString_STR_DQ1203110_quest_summary_:
Cavio, một người tị nạn từ Eiron, là một học giả nghiên cứu về sinh thái của Eltnen. Cavio muốn biết tại sao các sinh vật ở Đồi Eiron lại trở nên hung dữ hơn trước.

Đi săn các sinh vật xung quanh Trại Tị Nạn để thu thập mẫu mô.

Chúng rõ ràng đã tiến hóa để thích nghi với hào quang độc hại ở vùng đất này.

Cavio, một người tị nạn từ Đồi Eiron cũng là một học giả, đã yêu cầu tiến hành nghiên cứu sinh thái tại Đồi Eiron, vì các sinh vật ở khu vực này trở nên hung dữ hơn để tồn tại tốt hơn trong hào quang độc hại của vùng đất.

Vào ngày một ánh sáng lạ rơi từ bầu trời, tác động đã khiến toàn bộ thảm thực vật trên đồi héo úa. Hào quang độc hại phát ra từ thảm thực vật chết đã khiến các sinh vật trở nên thù địch hơn nhiều. Rõ ràng sự kiện này đã ảnh hưởng lớn đến Cavio.

Dù sao thì, chuyện đã rồi. Cavio thề sẽ tập trung vào những gì anh ấy có thể làm hiện tại.

Chúng rõ ràng đã tiến hóa để thích nghi với hào quang độc hại ở vùng đất này.

Vào ngày một ánh sáng lạ rơi xuống từ bầu trời, vụ va chạm đã khiến tất cả thảm thực vật trên đồi héo úa. Hào quang độc hại phát ra từ thảm thực vật chết đã khiến các sinh vật trở nên hung dữ hơn nhiều. Rõ ràng sự kiện này đã ảnh hưởng lớn đến Cavio.

The Daeva controlled by it seemed to be Fate Archons serving Empyrean Lord Marchutan.
And yet, the marks they carried bore an unfamiliar insignia.

Something strange was clearly happening in Morheim. Still, you pressed on to the Blades' secret storage.

"Just who could they be?"

"Looking for the Nornir, right? Try Patamor Village."

The storage had been carved out of a winding cave, with another cavern lying beyond its walls. Hearing a commotion from the other side, you peered through the narrow gap in the wall—only to realize you had stumbled upon a fierce battle.

Kromede, the infamous treasure hunter and villainess, was under attack by a group of Daeva. Fortunately, your intervention ensured her victory.

Grateful for the aid, Kromede informed you that the Nornir could be found in Patamor Village.

"Looking for the Nornir, right? Try Patamor Village."

As the last surviving settlement for humans and Daeva in Morheim, the village is reportedly quite insular.

"If you lend a hand, people will open up to you."

Patamor Village proved to be wary of outsiders, exactly as Nemon had predicted.
Initially, the village vigilante group blocked you from entering, but Elvida—the Nornir who assisted with your ascension in Ishalgen—appeared and vouched for you.

Unfortunately, the Sisters of Fate you had hoped to meet, Skuld and Verdandi, were away on research. Elvida suggested assisting the villagers while waiting for their return.

With how uncooperative the locals were, you decided to follow Elvida's advice and earn their favor through work.
However, upon meeting the Village Chief to offer your aid, you learned that Patamor was facing a dire crisis.

"If you lend a hand, people will open up to you."

The barrier safeguarding Patamor Village against the Balaur relies on the power of a Barrierstone installed by Skuld and Verdandi. According to Adelina, the elemental energy within the Barrierstone occasionally weakens, requiring regular patrols by the village vigilante group. However, the most recent patrol had missed their check-in.

Inspecting the Barrierstone with Adelina, it was discovered to have been destroyed in a Balaur attack, with the bodies of vigilante members scattered nearby.

But not all was lost. A handful of survivors, including Adelina's husband, seemingly survived and fled. With no time to waste, you pressed on toward their suspected hideout.

"I'm afraid something bad has happened..."

Worried for her husband, Adelina planned to shadow the party in secret instead of going back to the village. Realizing this, Nemon took it upon herself to escort Adelina back to safety.

Alone, you proceeded to the Hunter's Hideout and rescued Moreuk, the commander of the Vigilante Group.
Apparently, several of his crew members were trapped in Fafnium. You moved quickly to save them—but while two survived, one did not make it.
Devastated, Moreuk blamed the tragedy on his inadequacies as a commander.

According to him, the Barrierstone on the Sky Island was still safe, as the village barrier has not failed entirely.

"Your soul will soon be shattered..."

On the Sky Island in the Patamor Plains, Moreuk confirmed the Barrierstone remained secure. But your journey back to the village was violently interrupted by a sudden Balaur ambush.

These Balaur were not from Morheim—they were forces led by Indnath, who had relentlessly tracked Nemon ever since Altgard.
Indnath sought revenge for the theft of the High Priest's Fafnite and the destruction of the storage during the search for Zikel's Core.

You successfully repelled the ambush, and Indnath's lieutenant Kalakhar cursed Nemon on his dying breath.
Watching the scene unfold, Moreuk realized just how relentless the Balaur were about hunting down Nemon.

"Your soul will soon be shattered..."

With Moreuk confirming that the Sky Island's Barrierstone was secure, you turned back toward the village, only to walk right into an Balaur ambush. These Balaur were minions of <QK>Indnath</>—relentless stalkers who had been tracking Nemon since Altgard to avenge the High Priest's stolen Fafnite.

As you cut them down, Indnath’s lieutenant, Kalakhar, spat curses at Nemon on his dying breath, a chilling display that made Moreuk realize just how fiercely the Balaur were hunting her.

Now that Skuld and Verdandi have also returned, seek them out to learn more about Empyrean Lord Marchutan's Core.

"See you at the altar later."

Skuld and Verdandi finally returned to the village after completing their research. Despite having already heard the news from Urd, they focused not on Marchutan's Core, but something else entirely.

They were confident that they had found a more viable path toward saving the world. Since the village was hardly an appropriate location for the discussion, they arranged to meet at Verdandi's Altar.

Restoring the Barrierstone had to come first, but the material chest was empty.
Per the Sisters of Fate's request, you scavenged the required materials from the plains before making your way to Verdandi's Altar.

"See you at the altar later."

Skuld and Verdandi finally returned to the village after completing their research. However, instead of providing information on the Core of the Empyrean Lord, they divulged that there was a <QK>more viable path</> toward saving the world.

Inside the altar stood Indnath, who had pursued Nemon ever since Altgard. The bodies of Verdandi and Skuld lay cold at his feet.

As expected of the commander of the Lagta Brigade, Indnath proved a formidable opponent. Just as the situation was turning desperate, Kromede appeared and helped you escape. It seemed Kromede was also aware of the secret the sisters intended to share, and she suggested continuing the discussion at her Sky Island base.

News of the Nornir sisters' deaths soon reached Gottfried, the chief of Patamor Village. Having been briefed by Moreuk, he was already aware that formidable Balaur forces were pursuing Nemon.
Enraged, Gottfried accused Nemon of causing the Nornir's demise, calling her a walking calamity.

"This is life outside the Bulwark."

Inside Verdandi's Altar, you found Indnath standing over Verdandi and Skuld's lifeless bodies.

Just as Indnath's power began to overwhelm you, Kromede appeared to help. She also seemed to know about the sisters' <QK>plans to save the world</> as well, and told you to meet her at her Sky Island base.

Kromede shared a startling truth, claiming the Ascension Artifact was the key to ensuring the world's salvation—with a cryptic remark that the Fate Archons had actually disappeared long ago with Empyrean Lord Marchutan.

Kromede insisted that helping her find the Ascension Artifact was the only path toward achieving what everyone wants, regardless of whether you believed her or not.

"The true Fate Archons vanished with the Empyrean Lords a long time ago."

Burdened by guilt over the Nornir sisters' deaths, Nemon set off for the Sky Island to learn more from Kromede.

QuestString_STR_HQ2103220_quest_summary_:
The search for the Ascension Artifact's location points to the Nephra Snowfield.
Meet Zebas, who is already investigating the area, to learn what progress has been made.

"A voice? That's the first I've heard of anything like that..."

Kromede insisted on finding the Ascension Artifact, since it held the power to save the world. However, she was hardly the only one coveting it, as the fake Fate Archons under Dragon Lord Fafnir's command had already made their move as well.

You set off to Nephra Snowfield in search of the truth, and met with Zebas—who had already been searching for Artifact fragments. After hearing that the search party sent ahead had gone missing, you rushed to the search site, only to be attacked by the now-deranged members and a mysterious Fate Archon.

Upon defeating them, you recovered a fragment that seemed to echo with a peculiar resonance—and a mysterious voice.

"A voice? That's the first I've heard of anything like that..."

You rushed to Nephra Snowfield in the hopes of securing the Ascension Artifact before the fake Fate Archons allied with the Balaur.

At the site where the search party vanished, you encountered its bewitched members and a mysterious Fate Archon. Once you subdued them, you recovered an Artifact fragment echoing with an <QK>unknown voice</>.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103220_quest_short_su: Talk to Kromede on Kromede's Island
QuestString_STR_HQ2103220_complete_desc: Talk to Zebas at Frostwind Forward Base
QuestString_STR_HQ2103240_quest_summary_:
Zebas has offered to provide information on the Fate Archons in exchange for your help.
Cooperate with him and investigate the potential fragment sites scattered throughout the snowfield.

"Do you still mean to continue your search?"

Zebas offered to provide information on the Fate Archons in exchange for your help. Under his guidance, you dealt with nearby interlopers and looked for more fragments, only to find ones that were unresponsive.

Losing patience with the fruitless investigation, Nemon pressured Zebas and demanded information regarding the true Fate Archons and the High Priest.

Eventually, Zebas revealed the existence of an old Fate Archon stronghold in the snowfield that was now occupied by the fake Fate Archons. Despite being warned of the extreme danger, you headed to the Destroyed Fafnium Site in search of the truth.

"Do you still mean to continue your search?"

Despite searching throughout the snowfield with Zebas, there were no meaningful results.

Losing patience with the fruitless investigation, Nemon pushed Zebas for details regarding the true Fate Archons and the High Priest. Reluctantly, he informed you of the <QK>Destroyed Fafnium Site</>.

QuestString_STR_HQ2103260_quest_summary_:
A strange note was found at an abandoned outpost near the Destroyed Fafnium Site.
Use the code Nemon deciphered to search for clues around the Slumbering Frozen Lake.

"... Yes, you're right. It's too soon to say."

A note was found at an abandoned outpost near the Slumbering Frozen Lake. Though it initially appeared to be an ordinary letter, Nemon was able to decipher a hidden phrase: "cave inside the lake."

With lingering doubts, you approached the Slumbering Frozen Lake. There, you found a hidden cave that was clearly once inhabited by someone. It also had a Daeva Mark different to those seen on the Patamor Plains.

Documents and circumstantial evidence suggested that the cave had been occupied by the true Fate Archons. Although none could be found within, Nemon remained hopeful that some may be found alive elsewhere, just as Reuben had been found in Altgard.

"... Yes, you're right. It's too soon to say."

After deciphering the code <QK>"cave inside the lake"</> from a note found at an abandoned outpost, you uncovered a hidden shelter for the true Fate Archons beneath the Slumbering Frozen Lake.

The Daeva Marks found there differed from those belonging to the fake Fate Archons encountered so far, confirming that the true Fate Archons had survived.

QuestString_STR_HQ2103280_quest_summary_:
A hideout presumed to have been used by the true Fate Archons has been discovered.
Cooperate with Netra to eliminate the Balaur in the area and follow the traces left behind.

"There really might be survivors."

Netra was quite pessimistic when you met her at the Destroyed Fafnium Site, stating that Fate Archons capable of reason were practically nonexistent as of late. Nevertheless, you continued searching for evidence as you dealt with the Balaur nearby.

The investigation soon led to Snowshade Hideout, where you found recently discarded luggage and old Marks. Clearly, the true Fate Archons had been hiding there.

Based on the information you had gathered, the survivors had most likely been captured and sent to the execution grounds. Time was of the essence if you were to rescue any of them, so you headed there immediately.

"There really might be survivors."

Despite Netra's claim that the true Fate Archons were likely wiped out, investigations of their hideout revealed signs of recent activity.

The evidence indicated that the survivors had been captured and sent to the <QK>execution grounds</>—meaning time was of the essence if you were to rescue any of them. You departed immediately.

QuestString_STR_HQ2103300_quest_summary_:
The fake Fate Archons are preparing a gruesome execution.
Rush to the execution grounds and rescue the surviving true Fate Archons.

"This is what happens to those who resist!"

Not long after arriving at the execution grounds, you witnessed the fake Fate Archons' maniacal execution ceremony, where they vowed to eradicate all who opposed them.

After eliminating them, you managed to rescue a true Fate Archon bound to the gibbet—Cedra. Miraculously, she was still alive, though in critical condition.

Once Netra, who had caught up with the party, administered emergency treatment, you decided to move Cedra to the base at the Destroyed Fafnium Site for further care.

"This is what happens to those who resist!"

After disrupting the frenzied ritual held by the fake Fate Archons at the execution grounds, you rescued the true Fate Archon, <QK>Cedra</>, from the brink of death.

As she was in critical condition, she was handed over to Netra to be given further treatment at the base. You followed in the hope she could provide further information.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103300_quest_short_su: Talk to Netra at the Destroyed Fafnium Site

QuestString_STR_HQ2103310_quest_summary_:
Cedra mumbled the words "abandoned house" before losing consciousness once more.
Go to the abandoned house in the southeast Netra mentioned to check for any other survivors.

"My comrades still in the tower... Take them to the Fate Hideout..."

Though Cedra regained consciousness, her mind was broken by torture. Babbling incoherently, she repeatedly muttered only the words "High Priest" and "abandoned house." Netra informed you of an abandoned house located in the southeast.

There, you discovered another survivor named Petto. Collapsed and on the edge of death, he informed you that Sigebert, the High Priest of Fate, had imprisoned the remaining true Fate Archons in the Executioner's Tower. His final plea as he handed over the Seal of Marchutan was for you to save his comrades.

Nemon steeled her resolve, declaring she would infiltrate the Executioner's Tower and rescue as many true Fate Archons as possible.

"My comrades still in the tower... Take them to the Fate Hideout..."

Searching the abandoned house Cedra mentioned led to another survivor: Petto. Unfortunately, he died shortly after informing you that his comrades were imprisoned in the <QK>Executioner's Tower</>.

Taking the Seal of Marchutan Petto left behind, Nemon decided to head to the tower to rescue the remaining true Fate Archons trapped inside.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103310_quest_short_su: Talk to Netra at the Destroyed Fafnium Site

QuestString_STR_HQ2103320_quest_summary_:
On his deathbed, Petto—the final survivor—revealed that his comrades were being held captive in the Executioner's Tower.
Go to the Executioner's Tower occupied by the fake Fate Archons and rescue the surviving true Fate Archons.

"All that's left... is that land of fire and ash."

Netra strongly advised against entering the Executioner's Tower due to the extreme danger, but Nemon pressed on regardless. After causing a diversion and taking out the enemies nearby, the party successfully breached the tower.

There were no surviving true Fate Archons, only the insane and brainwashed Frozen Executor Erne, who promptly attacked. Once more, Kromede arrived to provide her assistance just as the situation turned most desperate.

The evidence thus far confirmed that the true Fate Archons had been wiped out and that Marchutan was currently held captive by Dragon Lord Fafnir.

Kromede pointed to Iralcig Highland as the next stop, certain that the Artifact was not in the snowfield. Although she appeared hesitant to travel there, there was little choice with no other options at hand.

"All that's left... is that land of fire and ash."

Despite Netra's objections, you breached the Executioner's Tower confirming that the remaining true Fate Archons had all been wiped out, and that Marchutan was Fafnir's captive.

Based on Kromede's assessment that the Artifact could not be found in the snowfield, the party headed for <QK>Iralcig Highland</>.

QuestString_STR_HQ2103340_quest_summary_:
The temporary alliance formed with Kromede to secure Marchutan's Core led to a new search for the Ascension Artifact.
Search Iralcig Highland to locate the Ascension Artifact.

"The squad captured a fake Fate Archon. They said they were searching for an Artifact here under orders from the High Priest."

Kromede and her followers have been scouring Morheim in search of the Ascension Artifact for a long time.
Yet, no meaningful progress has been made until now.
One of her former devoted followers, Milora, grew weary of the desolate conditions and began to complain.

Kromede pacified Milora by claiming to have captured someone who could provide a clue, while suggesting that Nemon come along.

Under Kromede's watchful eye, Nemon confronted the prisoner to uncover the relationship between the fake Fate Archons and the High Priest.

"The squad captured a fake Fate Archon. They said they were searching for an Artifact here under orders from the High Priest."

Thanks to Kromede's efforts, a fake Fate Archon with knowledge of the Ascension Artifact was captured and interrogated.
Nemon seeks to uncover the connection between the fake Fate Archons and the High Priest.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103340_quest_short_su: Talk to Kromede on Kromede's Island
QuestString_STR_HQ2103340_step3: Assess the situation at the outpost

QuestString_STR_HQ2103360_quest_summary_: With Kromede's help, Nemon interrogates a fake Fate Archon to learn the High Priest's whereabouts.

"Sigebert led us to our destiny. He forged the path himself instead of following that worthless Marchutan."

The fake Fate Archon finally yielded to Kromede's arts of persuasion and intimidation.

According to the fake Fate Archon, Sigebert assumed the mantle of High Priest in place of Empyrean Lord Marchutan. Supposedly, Sigebert has paved the path forward for all Daeva ever since—and his search for the Ascension Artifact has been fueled by the power Dragon Lord Fafnir bestowed on him.

Most important of all, however, was the revelation that Sigebert had relocated to the coast due to his keen interest in the Floating Temple of Arkanis.

"Sigebert led us to our destiny. He forged the path himself instead of following that worthless Marchutan."

During the interrogation at Iralcig Highland, the fake Fate Archon revealed that the power wielded by their High Priest was granted by Dragon Lord Fafnir himself.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103360_quest_short_su: Talk to Nemon in front of the Burned Village
QuestString_STR_HQ2103360_complete_desc: Talk to Eyrin at the Searcher Campsite
QuestString_STR_HQ2103380_quest_summary_:
Nemon and Kromede learned that Sigebert has his eye on the Floating Temple of Arkanis.
However, since ways to access to the temple and Sigebert's exact whereabouts remain a mystery, you must first meet with Eyrin near the coast.

"The closer you get to the Floating Temple, the stricter the security becomes."

Eyrin, who has been active near the coast, reported that the Krall of the Taytra Brigade—yet another group following the orders of Sigebert—recently tightened security around the north of the Floating Temple.

The party searched through documents left behind by the Taytra Brigade and the fake Fate Archon forces and analyzed them for leads on Sigebert.

"The closer you get to the Floating Temple, the stricter the security becomes."

Eyrin reported that the Taytra Krall had tightened security near the Floating Temple.

Determined to ascertain a path to the temple, the party examined Krall documents and Fate Archon logs, and eventually uncovered a critical lead.

QuestString_STR_HQ2103400_quest_summary_:
Discovered documents suggest that it is highly likely Sigebert has already gained access to the Floating Temple.
However, the area remains sealed and cannot be accessed without a special Mark. Secure one for yourself from the coastal base.

"Yes. It's highly likely he's already at the Floating Temple. And he's sealed the route there."

The revelations in the document were shocking. Sigebert had not only arrived at the Floating Temple but had also sealed the path there to ward off any pursuers.
The party hurried onward, fearful that any delay would mean risking the loss of the Ascension Artifact.

Entry into the Floating Temple required the Mark of a high-ranking fake Fate Archon.
After taking down a high-ranking fake Fate Archon and claiming their Mark, the party moved toward the large wall located in the northern edge of the Floating Temple.

"Yes. It's highly likely he's already at the Floating Temple. And he's sealed the route there."

The party learned that Sigebert had sealed the Temple Access Path.
In order to acquire the Mark of a high-ranking fake Fate Archon and remove the seal, the party searched the coastal base and eliminated the Watchers there.

QuestString_STR_HQ2103420_quest_summary_:
The Mark revealed a secret passage.
The party needs to keep advancing and open the portal to the Floating Temple of Arkanis.

"The Ascension Artifact... We're almost there."

Holding the Mark seized from the fake Fate Archons against the wall revealed the entrance to a hidden cave.

Inside the cave, the party defeated the guards blocking the way and eventually found a portal leading to the Floating Temple.

Before entering the portal, Kromede advised Valter to return, as his incomplete Ascension could cause the portal to harm him.
He was asked instead to return to the Sky Island and deliver the good news to everyone.


Despite his disappointment, Valter reluctantly agreed, knowing that it was an important mission of its own.

"The Ascension Artifact... We're almost there."

Holding the Mark seized from the fake Fate Archons against the wall revealed the entrance to a hidden cave.

After eliminating the guards inside, the party successfully found the portal to the Floating Temple.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103420_quest_short_su: Talk to Nemon at the Coastal Cave Entrance
QuestString_STR_HQ2103420_step1: Find the path to the Floating Temple of Arkanis
QuestString_STR_HQ2103420_complete_desc: Talk to Nemon at the Floating Temple of Arkanis Entrance
QuestString_STR_HQ2103440_quest_summary_:
Sigebert must be stopped before the Ascension Artifact falls into his hands.
Despite the uncertainty of what hazards lie inside the Floating Temple, the party must advance swiftly while relying on their own abilities to survive.

"He's just one man in the end. There are three of us."

The overwhelming power emanating from the Floating Temple of Arkanis prompted Nemon to urge caution. Kromede, however, urged everyone to make haste by eliminating any and all obstacles in the way, especially seeing as how the enemy was alone.

At the top floor of the Floating Temple the party finally encountered Sigebert, who had already claimed the Ascension Artifact. You charged toward him, intent on seizing it-but that was when the Artifact began resonating with a mysterious voice that paralyzed everyone—save for Kromede.

Oblivious to the situation, Kromede used this opportunity to draw her bow and shoot the Artifact, hoping to knock it out of everyone's reach. Though her aim was true, it sent the Artifact plummeting far below to the distant ground.

This unexpected little stunt broke the Artifact's hold on everyone. But Sigebert, whose obsession with the Artifact rivaled even Kromede's, dove after the Artifact as soon as it plummeted-with Kromede close behind.

"He's just one man in the end. There are three of us."

At the top floor of the Floating Temple the party finally encountered Sigebert, who had already claimed the Ascension Artifact. As the party commenced the attack, Kromede's arrow struck the Ascension Artifact, causing it to plummet to the ground below.

Compelled by their fixation on the Ascension Artifact, both Kromede and Sigebert dove after it.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103440_quest_short_su: Talk to Nemon at the Floating Temple of Arkanis Entrance
QuestString_STR_HQ2103440_step1_obj_1: Investigate the Floating Temple of Arkanis
QuestString_STR_HQ2103440_complete_desc: Talk to Nemon at the Floating Temple of Arkanis Entrance
QuestString_STR_HQ2103460_quest_summary_: The party heads back to Kromede's island in the hope that she has returned unharmed after she fell with the Ascension Artifact.

"Are these the only two Kromede could convince to follow her?"

During the resonance triggered by the Ascension Artifact, Asahr offered a clue on ascendingto an Arch Daeva.
Uncertain how much time had passed, the party held onto the hope that Kromede might have returned safely. Hope that was swiftly dashed.

While inquiring about Kromede's whereabouts from her followers, the party learned of symbols suggesting she was imprisoned in the Fire Temple of the Muspel Volcano Zone.
Eyrin, a Spiritmaster, surmised that the timing of the lost clues and the state of the local Spirits suggested the event occurred immediately after the incident at the Floating Temple.

Having found herself at a crossroads, where her efforts have come to nothing and her future survival is uncertain, Milora chose a different path from those seeking to save Kromede.

"Are these the only two Kromede could convince to follow her?"

Following the incident at the Floating Temple, the party held onto the hope that Kromede might have returned safely. Hope that was swiftly dashed.

The party came across a symbol indicating that Kromede had been imprisoned in the Fire Temple in the Muspel Volcano Zone.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103460_quest_short_su: Talk to Nemon at the Floating Temple of Arkanis Entrance

QuestString_STR_HQ2103460_step6: Head to the outskirts of Kromede's Island

QuestString_STR_HQ2103480_quest_summary_:
Zebas is the one searching for Kromede in Muspel Volcano Zone, but no one has been able to reach him.
Find him and join the search for Kromede and the Ascension Artifact.

"I am Ganetri, a spirit who aided Kromede in guarding the Fire Temple."

Zebas has gone missing while searching for traces of Kromede in Muspel Volcano Zone.

The party combed through the entire area, eventually finding him inside a cave. It turned out that he was lured by Kromede's voice, only to encounter hostile Spirits protecting a suspicious mirror.

One of the Spirits, Ganetri, initiated a conversation, which quickly resolved any misunderstandings. Ganetri informed the party that Kromede had fought against Sigebert not too long ago in the cave, and that entering the Fire Temple would require either Kromede or Agnita's powers.

He also added that he could sense Kromede's presence somewhere up north.

"I am Ganetri, a spirit who aided Kromede in guarding the Fire Temple."

During the search for Kromede, the party discovered Zebas—one of Kromede's missing followers—in a cave protected by Fire Spirits.

One of the Spirits who was protecting the mirror, Ganetri, informed you that the Fire Seal was required to gain entry into the Fire Temple.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103480_quest_short_su: Talk to Eyrin on Kromede's Island
QuestString_STR_HQ2103480_complete_desc: Talk to Zebas at the First Fragment Cave
QuestString_STR_HQ2103500_quest_summary_:
Ganetri, the Spirit aiding Kromede, claimed to sense Kromede's presence somewhere up north.
Investigate the area to pinpoint the exact location.

"The Krall under Sigebert's command were controlling the spirits."

Ganetri was right; the Fire Spirits beyond the cave were indeed acting strangely. Sigebert's Krall force—the Kurpak Unit—had used restraints to control the Spirits, severing their connection with Eyrin.


Ambushing the Kurpak Unit revealed two key truths. Firstly, Kromede came into possession of the Ascension Artifact after her fall from the Floating Temple.Secondly, in pursuit of her, Sigebert relocated the Kurpak Unit from Iralcig to Muspel Volcano Zone to establish control over the area. However, because he lacked the manpower, he eventually opted to shackle the Fire Spirits to support his local operations.

"The Krall under Sigebert's command were controlling the spirits."

The party ambushed the Kurpak Unit, and discovered that Kromede was in possession of the Ascension Artifact—causing Sigebert to relocate his forces in pursuit of her.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103500_quest_short_su: Talk to Zebas at the First Fragment Cave
QuestString_STR_HQ2103500_step1_obj_1: Go to where the evidence might be

QuestString_STR_HQ2103520_quest_summary_:
The Kurpak Unit's logs and Ganetri's directions seem to suggest there's another cave to the north.
Go to the cave and investigate what happened to find a way into the Fire Temple.

"You want to help her? ...Alright."

Despite hearing Kromede's resolute voice from outside the cave, all the party found inside was a lone mirror and scattered Fire Aura.

During the investigation, you encountered Kromede's disembodied voice from beyond the mirror, requesting that the Fire Aura be returned. Channeling the Fire Aura into the miror manifested an apparition of Kromede, made to protect the Fire Seal.

The apparition was relieved to know the real Kromede had entered the Fire Temple, and equally devastated that she was too weak to use the Seal after battling Sigebert.

She bestowed the party with the yet dormant Fire Seal, pleading with you to save Kromede.

"You want to help her? ...Alright."

Kromede's disembodied voice requested that the Fire Aura be returned to the mirror. Upon completing the request, an apparition of Kromede herself manifested—bestowing you the yet dormant Fire Seal needed to enter the Fire Temple.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103520_quest_short_su: Talk to Nemon at the Second Fragment Cave entrance
QuestString_STR_HQ2103520_complete_desc: Talk to Nemon at the Second Fragment Cave
QuestString_STR_HQ2103540_quest_summary_: Now that entry into the Fire Temple has been secured, Nemon plans to contact Kromede's followers for their aid. Collect enough Fire Aura to activate the Fire Seal.

"Well, this is everyone. You were right."

The Fire Seal was ready, and the path to the temple was clear. Yet there were few who wished to help the party, save for the most resolute of them all—Zebas, Eyrin, and Valter. Together, you ventured toward the Fire Temple.

"Well, this is everyone. You were right."

Once the Fire Seal was ready, you regrouped with Nemon, who brought some of Kromede's followers. True to what she had predicted, few had volunteered for the mission—still, the mission to save Kromede must proceed.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103540_quest_short_su: Talk to Nemon at the Second Fragment Cave

QuestString_STR_HQ2103560_quest_summary_:
To reach the Fire Temple, one must get past the Fire Plaza—but something has set off the statues guarding it.
Defeat the statues to clear the path to the temple.

"Think you can handle me?"

With the endless onslaught brought on by the Fire Temple's guardian statues, Nemon, Zebas, and Eyrin had to stall for time while you and Valter infiltrated the building.

Yet no one could anticipate Kromede's decision to hurl herself into the depths of the mirror. Realizing how futile her efforts had been, she had lost all reason and levelled her blade towards you.

Eventually, she fell in battle, her form scattering into embers that would remain in the Fire Temple for an indefinite period of time.

"Think you can handle me?"

Although you and Valter successfully infiltrated the Fire Temple, you couldn't protect Kromede from herself. Choosing to become desire incarnate, Kromede eventually fell in battle, and vanished into the depths of the mirror.
QuestString_STR_HQ2103560_quest_short_su: Talk to Zebas at Muspel Volcano Zone

QuestString_STR_HQ2103580_quest_summary_:
In the end, the party left the Fire Temple, unable to rescue Kromede.
Her followers are in mourning. Best give them some space.

"What happened is unfortunate, but Kromede isn't completely gone. She's just guarding the Fire Temple in a different form now."

Kromede's followers could not easily come to terms with the decision she had made.

Nemon was also disappointed, as all the effort she spent on finding the Core with Kromede had amounted to nothing. Nevertheless, she offered reassurance that tracking down Siegbert would lead to both the Core and the Ascension Artifact.

The party returned to the Sky Island—now devoid of its owner—to get ready for the next stage of their journey.
Their hopes are now placed on the Fate Hideout that Petto had mentioned in his dying breath.

"What happened is unfortunate, but Kromede isn't completely gone. She's just guarding the Fire Temple in a different form now."

Kromede's followers could not easily come to terms with the decision she had made.

Nemon, similarly disappointed by the outcome, suggested returning to Kromede's Island to regroup and continue the search for the Core.
